items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I love George. He was so nice... We had a band in Crockett... And George is the fireman's head on.

ctx.x: he begged him so much to get this taken off of this. So he went to Mr. Coleman and Coleman took her from that and that's all, yeah. Look, a Georgie was about, oh, about 14 or 12 years. George Brunus? Yeah,

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: But I played with him. ... I said that Brunus boy hired us for across the river?

ctx.x: They won't hire him because he's an old man, you see? But I played with him. You know that, uh, you know that time you, uh... I see. You know that time I said that Brunus boy hired us for across the river? Yeah. I got Emile. I've been recording with Emile, too.
Yeah. Emile is, I tell you, he's... Emile is about 64 years old.
